headline: Government hikes windfall tax on diesel and ATF exports, zeros petrol duty
hook: Windfall tax tweaked on diesel and ATF
summary: The central government has revised windfall profit taxes, raising the special additional excise duty on aviation turbine fuel exports to ₹11 per litre from ₹10.50. Meanwhile, the export duty on petrol has been reduced to zero. These fortnightly revisions impact upstream oil producers and fuel exporters. Indian retail investors should monitor margins for domestic refiners like ONGC and Reliance Industries.
whats_next: Next fortnightly windfall tax revision in two weeks
why_it_matters: Refining margins shift for major fuel exporters.
winners_losers: Petrol exporters gain / ATF exporters hurt

headline: Centre scraps export duty on petrol while raising levies on diesel and ATF
hook: Refining margins shift for domestic oil firms
summary: The central government has completely removed the export tax on petrol. At the same time, export levies on high-speed diesel and aviation turbine fuel have been increased. These adjustments in export duties reflect shifting international product margins and domestic supply dynamics. Indian oil refiners will face altered export economics following these tax revisions.
whats_next: Next fortnightly windfall tax review cycle
why_it_matters: Refiner export margins shift as diesel and ATF taxes rise
winners_losers: Petrol exporters gain / diesel exporters hurt

headline: ONGC fixes November 12 as record date for upcoming dividend
summary: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited has announced that November 12, 2026, will serve as the record date for determining shareholders eligible for its upcoming dividend. Eligible investors holding the stock as of this date will receive the announced payout. This corporate action directly impacts current shareholders by confirming the timeline for their dividend credit. Indian retail investors holding ONGC in their portfolios should note this date to ensure eligibility for the payout.
why_it_matters: Hold shares by record date to secure dividend payout

headline: Supreme Court hears Reliance Industries' appeal against ONGC in gas dispute
hook: Supreme Court reviews long-standing gas dispute
summary: The Supreme Court has begun hearing an appeal filed by Reliance Industries regarding a long-standing dispute over natural gas migration from ONGC's blocks. The case centers on allegations that Reliance extracted gas that originated in ONGC's adjacent fields in the Krishna-Godavari basin. This legal battle has persisted for years, involving significant claims for compensation and damages. The outcome could impact the financial liabilities of both energy giants.
why_it_matters: Potential financial liability for Reliance or compensation windfall for ONGC.

headline: Kotak Securities raises FY27 crude forecast to $100 and lifts ONGC and Oil India estimates
hook: Kotak flags 57 percent upside for ONGC
summary: Kotak Securities has raised its FY27 crude oil price assumption to $100 per barrel due to supply risks. Consequently, the brokerage upgraded earnings estimates for state-run producers ONGC and Oil India. ONGC is named the preferred pick with a fair value of ₹360, while Oil India has a fair value of ₹365. Indian retail investors tracking upstream oil stocks may see shifting sentiment based on these revised brokerage targets.
whats_next: FY27 crude price realizations and actual production updates
why_it_matters: Higher crude forecasts alter valuation targets for upstream oil stocks.
winners_losers: ONGC gains / Oil India pressured by targets

headline: Nifty Oil & Gas index drops over 2% in biggest slide since October
hook: Oil and gas stocks face sharp sell-off
summary: The Nifty Oil & Gas index fell by more than 2% today, marking its steepest decline since October 8. Heavyweights Reliance Industries and ONGC led the downward trend, dragging the sector index lower. This sell-off reflects broader market pressure on energy stocks during the trading session. The movement impacts portfolios heavily weighted in energy and oil marketing companies.
why_it_matters: Energy sector volatility impacts Nifty index performance and your portfolio.
winners_losers: Energy sector hurt / No clear winners

headline: ONGC shares trade below key technical support level
hook: ONGC stock slips under critical support
summary: ONGC shares have fallen below a significant technical support threshold, signaling potential bearish momentum. The stock is currently facing selling pressure as it struggles to maintain its recent price floor. This technical breakdown may lead to further volatility for the oil and gas major. Retail investors holding the stock should note the increased risk of a downward trend following this breach.
why_it_matters: Technical breakdown may signal further short-term price decline for holders.
winners_losers: Short sellers gain / Long-term holders hurt

headline: Oil prices rise following Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities
hook: Red Sea tensions push crude prices higher
summary: Crude oil prices rebounded as Houthi militant attacks on Saudi Arabian infrastructure disrupted supply sentiment. These strikes overshadowed ongoing diplomatic efforts to de-escalate regional tensions in the Middle East. Higher oil prices directly impact India's import bill and current account deficit. Retail investors should note the potential for inflationary pressure on domestic fuel and transport costs.
why_it_matters: Rising oil costs increase domestic inflation and pressure the rupee.
winners_losers: Upstream oil producers gain / OMCs and consumers hurt

headline: S&P Global Ratings projects 15-20% EBITDA growth for ONGC in FY27
hook: Stronger upstream output and downstream recovery ahead
summary: S&P expects Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) to maintain quarterly domestic oil and gas production at approximately 10 million tonnes. This output translates to 73.5 million barrels of oil, driving projected quarterly EBITDA between ₹25,000 crore and ₹30,000 crore. The growth is underpinned by operational strength in upstream segments and a recovery in downstream activities. Retail investors tracking energy stocks will note this positive medium-term outlook for cash generation.
whats_next: FY27 financial performance and production milestones
why_it_matters: Higher EBITDA projection signals stronger cash flows for ONGC shareholders.

headline: Ipca Laboratories and three other stocks show rising RSI momentum
summary: Ipca Laboratories, Shree Cement, JSW Cement, and Oil & Natural Gas Corporation appeared in StockEdge's RSI Trending Up scan on October 23. The scan indicates improving price momentum across these four equities. Technical indicators like the Relative Strength Index highlight potential shifting trends for retail participants tracking momentum. These technical scans help identify stocks experiencing buying interest.
why_it_matters: Momentum signals flag potential trading opportunities for technical traders.

headline: ONGC share price drops below its 20-day exponential moving average
hook: Slipped past key short-term moving average
summary: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation shares saw a price drop, falling below their 20-day exponential moving average during live trading sessions. This technical indicator shift signals potential near-term weakness in the stock's momentum. Retail investors tracking momentum indicators may view this as a sign of cooling sentiment. Monitoring how the stock behaves around this technical threshold helps gauge near-term direction.
why_it_matters: Technical breakdown signals potential near-term weakness for ONGC holders

headline: Trading strategies for Bharti Airtel, ONGC, and others
hook: Technical setups for five active stocks
summary: Market analysts have provided technical trading outlooks for Bharti Airtel, ONGC, Anand Rathi Wealth, JSW Cement, and Firstsource Solutions. The analysis covers support and resistance levels to help traders identify potential entry and exit points. These stocks are currently being monitored for price momentum and chart patterns. Retail investors can use these technical insights to gauge short-term volatility in these specific counters.
why_it_matters: Technical levels help traders manage risk in volatile stocks.

headline: Government to fund half of deepwater well costs under Samudra Manthan scheme
hook: State absorbs deepwater exploration risk under Samudra Manthan
summary: The Indian government will finance up to 50% of the cost for 60 risky deepwater and ultra-deepwater exploration wells through the Rs 84,084-crore Samudra Manthan scheme. Under the operational guidelines, the state absorbs losses if no oil or gas is found, but expects repayment from revenues if production succeeds. The program specifically targets state-run firms or consortia they lead, aiming to reduce India's heavy reliance on imported hydrocarbons by FY2030-31. For retail investors, this significantly alters the risk-reward profile of state-run upstream energy companies undertaking expensive offshore exploration.
whats_next: Infrastructure Appraisal Board site selections within 60 days
why_it_matters: State-run explorers get financial backing for high-risk offshore drilling.
winners_losers: State-run upstream explorers gain / government absorbs dry-hole risk

headline: Government approves ₹84,000 crore Samudra Manthan deep-sea exploration project
summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the Samudra Manthan project, a ₹84,000 crore initiative focused on deep-sea exploration and mineral resource mapping. The project aims to identify potential mineral deposits in India's Exclusive Economic Zone to reduce import dependency. This long-term investment targets the development of deep-sea technologies and infrastructure over the coming years. It impacts domestic mining, engineering, and energy sectors involved in offshore exploration.
why_it_matters: Long-term boost for domestic mining and offshore engineering firms.

headline: Government to partially underwrite offshore oil and gas exploration risks
hook: Government to share offshore drilling risks
summary: The Indian government has introduced a new framework to accelerate offshore oil and gas exploration. Under this policy, the state will partially underwrite drilling risks to encourage investment in challenging offshore blocks. Private operators will continue to hold the majority of capital exposure and maintain full operational responsibility. This move aims to boost domestic energy production by lowering the financial barrier for exploration companies.
why_it_matters: Lower exploration risk may boost domestic oil and gas production.
winners_losers: Oil explorers gain / Government bears partial risk
